claims.claim: The registry selects brain-high-value-v3 for prospective canonical authoring, while historical v2 profiles and Stage-2 material retain direct validation support.
V3 TASK_AUTHORING requires bounded closed caller-context and canonical-shape sections with explicit coverage, non-applicability or blockage; shape coverage includes FAILURE and reviewed RESULT.
Terminal conformance requires all three PRIMARY, REMEDIATION and REPAIR publication paths; blocked conformance requires a closure BLOCKER and NO_DECISION.
Ingress validates closed v3 material, exact packet and reconciled-candidate bindings, coverage and blocker consistency before constructing authoring blobs, indexes, commits or ref updates.
The return contract documents v3 sections as bounded transient Brain support outside canonical TASK bytes, and v3 candidate validation rejects nested conformance sections.
Added regression fixtures cover caller-owned remote propagation, FAILURE plus reviewed-RESULT shape coverage, and blocked remediation publication under CANDIDATE closure.

V3 validation checks structural declarations without deriving semantic applicability or feasibility, requiring future lifecycle facts, or adding planning, verification, review, publication, routing or persistent reasoning authority.
